title: TensorPlate Scheduler Metrics Snapshot
description:
Snapshot of scheduler counters and aggregates returned by InferScheduler::metrics(). Mirrors include/tensorplate/scheduler/scheduler.hpp::SchedulerMetrics. Intended for the local /metrics endpoint (V01-E07), the local status command (V01-E11), and the observability service (V01-E12).

Counters are monotonic (always increase). Wait-time aggregates use steady-clock nanoseconds so durations are comparable across snapshots within a single process; the snapshot itself does not carry timestamps.

policy.description: Policy key echoed from the scheduler config. Same enum as config/schemas/scheduler.json, where 'session_round_robin' is reserved: no scheduler is registered under it.

in_flight.description: Logical in-flight count under its protocol 0.1 name, kept with this meaning: dispatched requests whose outcome is still open to the caller. A request cancelled while executing leaves this count when the cancellation is accepted. Always equal to in_flight_logical.

in_flight_high_water.description: Largest logical in-flight count observed since scheduler construction.

in_flight_logical.description: Dispatched requests whose outcome is still open to the caller. Optional: a writer without it omits the property, never writes null.

in_flight_physical.description: Dispatched requests the executor has not yet reported released, including requests cancelled while executing. Never less than in_flight_logical + in_flight_physical_cancelled. Queued requests are never counted. Optional: a writer without it omits the property, never writes null.

in_flight_physical_cancelled.description: Requests cancelled after dispatch that the executor has not yet reported released: counted in in_flight_physical, not in in_flight_logical. Optional: a writer without it omits the property, never writes null.

in_flight_physical_high_water.description: Largest in_flight_physical observed since scheduler construction. Optional: a writer without it omits the property, never writes null.

wait_time_sum_ns.description: Sum of monotonic queue wait times across dispatched, cancelled, and expired requests.

wait_time_samples.description: Number of requests that contributed to wait_time_sum_ns. Mean wait = sum / samples when samples > 0.

wait_time_max_ns.description: Largest monotonic queue wait observed since scheduler construction.
